text: GS Yuasa Corporation's principal shareholders as at 31 March 2026 are trust and custody banks - The Master Trust Bank of Japan (17.47%) and Custody Bank of Japan (9.69%) - with Honda Motor at 4.89%, Meiji Yasuda Life at 2.79% and Toyota Motor at 2.23%; no state or state fund appears among them.
short: GS Yuasa's largest holders are Japanese trust banks; Honda holds 4.89% and Toyota 2.23%.
